# CV Web Workspace Instructions

- Project stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- Goal: a polished CV/portfolio site with professional motion and a sophisticated visual style.
- Keep edits focused, minimal, and consistent with the existing design language.
- Update the README when adding new user-facing sections or setup steps.
- Use the current workspace root as the project root.
- Prefer concise progress updates and verify changes with a build or typecheck when possible.
